name: YamatoKatana
note: Two meshes: the katana (handle up, blade inside the sheath pointing down and a little sideways) and the sheath. Handle axis from pommel (0.138,0.062,1.334) to guard (0.089,0.088,1.137); the blade bows toward +X (edge), so the spine is the opposite way. 2048x4096 textures halved.
